claim.quote: The measured muon rate in DM-Ice17 is 2.93 +/- 0.04 muons/crystal/day with a modulation amplitude of 12.3 +/- 1.7%, consistent with expectation.

name: Measurement of Muon Annual Modulation and Muon-Induced Phosphorescence in NaI(Tl) Crystals with DM-Ice17

summary.plain: DM-Ice17 measured how often cosmic-ray muons cross its crystals and how that rate changes through the year, and found that the faint afterglow muons leave in the crystals cannot explain the yearly signal seen by DAMA.
summary.technical: Muon rate 2.93 +- 0.04 muons/crystal/day with annual modulation amplitude 12.3 +- 1.7%; muon-induced phosphorescence with decay time 5.5 +- 0.5 s, not mimicking a scintillation signal above 2 keVee (Phys. Rev. D 93, 042001).

title: Measurement of Muon Annual Modulation and Muon-Induced Phosphorescence in NaI(Tl) Crystals with DM-Ice17
why_it_matters: The paper concludes that phosphorescence with the properties observed in DM-Ice17 cannot account for the DAMA modulation.
